cues.en: Mike: As you know, correlation coefficients are bound between minus one and plus one, so it's not possible to have a correlation coefficient
cues.zh: Mike：你知道，相關係數受限於負 1 到正 1，所以相關係數不可能

cues.en: less than minus one, nor is it possible to have a correlation coefficient greater than one.
cues.zh: 小於負 1，也不可能大於 1。

cues.en: Now, that is not really a bug.
cues.zh: 這其實不是缺點。

cues.en: That's a feature.
cues.zh: 而是一項特性。

cues.en: That's by design, and very often, that's actually a very useful feature because it facilitates interpretation.
cues.zh: 它是刻意設計的，而且經常很有用，因為方便解讀。

cues.en: It means that our interpretation of the correlation coefficient is independent of the scale of the data.
cues.zh: 這表示相關係數的解讀不受資料尺度影響。

cues.en: However, depending on what you're doing with those correlation coefficients, you might need to apply a transformation to the correlations
cues.zh: 不過，依據你要如何使用這些相關係數，可能必須先轉換相關，

cues.en: before they can be used further.
cues.zh: 才能進一步使用。

cues.en: And so that's the idea of the Fisher-Z transformation, or maybe you call it Fisher-Z, depending on what side of the Atlantic you live on.
cues.zh: 這就是費雪 Z 轉換的概念；Z 的發音可能隨你住在大西洋哪一側而不同。

cues.en: And so in this video, I'm going to explain what the effect of the Fisher-Z transformation is, and I'll show you the two formulas
cues.zh: 這支影片會解釋費雪 Z 轉換的效果，並展示計算這個轉換的

cues.en: for computing that transformation.
cues.zh: 兩種公式。

cues.en: Okay, so this is a distribution of correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 這是一個相關係數分布。

cues.en: So we see that they are bound by minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 可以看到，受限於負 1 到正 1。

cues.en: So we get a uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 得到一個均勻分布。

cues.en: Correlation coefficients are uniformly distributed.
cues.zh: 相關係數呈均勻分布。

cues.en: They are not normally distributed.
cues.zh: 並不是常態分布。

cues.en: However, there are many analysis methods that assume that your data are drawn from normal or Gaussian distributions.
cues.zh: 然而，許多分析方法假設資料來自常態或高斯分布。

cues.en: So if you're just interpreting the correlation coefficient, and that's kind of the end goal of the analysis, you don't need to worry about it, but if you are computing correlations between variables,
cues.zh: 如果只是解讀相關係數，而且那就是分析的最終目標，就不必擔心。但如果計算變數間的相關，

cues.en: and let's say you do lots and lots of correlations, and then you are doing some kind of secondary analysis on those correlation coefficients,
cues.zh: 而且算了很多很多相關，再對這些相關係數進行某種二次分析，

cues.en: then you might need to transform the correlations into a Gaussian scale or roughly Gaussian scale.
cues.zh: 可能就需要把相關轉成高斯尺度，或大致高斯的尺度。

cues.en: So that's the idea of the Fisher-Z transform.
cues.zh: 這就是費雪 Z 轉換的概念。

cues.en: We take a distribution that looks like this, a uniform distribution between minus one and plus one, and we transform that into a roughly Gaussian distribution
cues.zh: 把這種負 1 到正 1 之間的均勻分布，轉成大致的高斯分布，

cues.en: also with the mean at zero, and you can see that these values now go up to, you know, around minus four.
cues.zh: 平均值同樣在 0，而且可以看到，現在數值可以到大約負 4。

cues.en: They can get a little bit bigger than this.
cues.zh: 也可以比這個更大一些。

cues.en: So that's the idea.
cues.zh: 概念就是這樣。

cues.en: So here is the formula for the Fisher-Z transform.
cues.zh: 這是費雪 Z 轉換的公式。

cues.en: So the Z-transform of the correlation coefficient R is one half of the natural log of one plus R divided by one minus R.
cues.zh: 相關係數 r 的 Z 轉換，是 1 加 r 除以 1 減 r，再取自然對數，最後乘上二分之一。

cues.en: Now remember some features of the logarithm.
cues.zh: 記得對數的一些性質。

cues.en: So the log of a negative number, it doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 負數的對數不存在。

cues.en: It's not defined, at least not in the real world.
cues.zh: 它沒有定義，至少在實數範圍內沒有。

cues.en: In the complex world, we can get solutions, but in the real world, that's not defined.
cues.zh: 在複數範圍可以得到解，但實數範圍沒有定義。

cues.en: And the log of a number between zero and one is gonna be a negative number, and the log of a number that's greater than one is going to be a positive number.
cues.zh: 0 到 1 之間數字的對數會是負數，大於 1 的數字取對數則是正數。

cues.en: So I would like you to pause the video and work through a few different examples of what the end result is going to be here.
cues.zh: 希望你暫停影片，用幾個不同例子，推想這裡最後的結果。

cues.en: Now you don't need to do these exactly numerically, but just keeping in mind that when this quantity inside the logarithm, when this is greater than one,
cues.zh: 不需要精確算出數字，只要記住，對數裡的這個量大於 1 時，

cues.en: then the log is going to be positive.
cues.zh: 對數就會是正的。

cues.en: When this is between zero and one, then this is going to be negative.
cues.zh: 當它在 0 到 1 之間，對數就會是負的。

cues.en: That's mainly what I would like you to think about.
cues.zh: 這是主要希望你思考的事情。

cues.en: So just in your mind, walk through various, couple of different values of R, and it doesn't matter what the exact number here is, just whether they are positive or negative.
cues.zh: 在腦中試幾個不同 r 值，不需要知道精確結果，只要知道結果是正還是負。

cues.en: And I would also like you to think of some failure scenarios.
cues.zh: 也希望你想想，哪些情境會失敗。

cues.en: So it turns out that there are actually two cases, two specific correlation values where the Fisher-Z transform actually breaks down, or it doesn't work.
cues.zh: 其實有兩種情況、兩個特定的相關值，會讓費雪 Z 轉換失效，無法運作。

cues.en: Now, if you've taken an advanced trigonometry or maybe an advanced calculus course, this kind of a formula might actually look a little bit familiar.
cues.zh: 如果上過進階三角學，或進階微積分，這種公式可能有點眼熟。

cues.en: In fact, this turns out to be the inverse hyperbolic tangent of R.
cues.zh: 它其實就是 r 的反雙曲正切。

cues.en: So arctanh, this is the inverse of the arc hyperbolic tangent of the correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 也就是 arctanh，對相關係數取反雙曲正切。

cues.en: So this is the shortcut formula.
cues.zh: 這是簡便的公式。

cues.en: This is like the full formula, and I like to show this in teaching because it's useful to kind of think through various scenarios of the correlation
cues.zh: 這是完整公式；教學時我喜歡展示它，因為可以用來思考不同相關值的情境，

cues.en: and how that can give positive versus negative numbers, or the number of value of zero is that value of zero, what R, what correlation coefficient
cues.zh: 為什麼會得到正數或負數，或者 0；也就是什麼 r、什麼相關係數，

cues.en: will give a Fisher-Z transform of zero.
cues.zh: 會讓費雪 Z 轉換等於 0。

cues.en: But in practice, it's generally just implemented as the arc hyperbolic tangent.
cues.zh: 但實際使用時，通常直接以反雙曲正切實作。

cues.en: Okay, so what I'm showing you here is just an illustration of the effect of the Fisher-Z transform for different particular values of a correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這裡只是示範，費雪 Z 轉換對不同特定相關係數的影響。

cues.en: So what we have here is just sorted indices.
cues.zh: 這裡是排序後的索引。

cues.en: This X-axis is kind of arbitrary, it doesn't really matter, and the important thing is the Y-axis here.
cues.zh: X 軸有點任意，並不重要，重要的是 Y 軸。

cues.en: So this is the value.
cues.zh: 這是數值。

cues.en: It's either the correlation or the Fisher-Z transform of the correlation.
cues.zh: 可能是相關，也可能是相關的費雪 Z 轉換。

cues.en: So notice the blue line, that's our actual correlations.
cues.zh: 注意藍線，這是實際相關。

cues.en: These are the R values.
cues.zh: 就是 r 值。

cues.en: They vary from minus one up to plus one, and they go up sort of linearly because that's how I define them, and then we have the Fisher-Z transform,
cues.zh: 從負 1 到正 1，以大致線性的方式上升，因為我是那樣定義的。接著有費雪 Z 轉換，

cues.en: and what I want you to notice is that the Fisher-Z transform actually doesn't have a really strong effect on most of the values.
cues.zh: 希望你注意，費雪 Z 轉換對大部分數值的影響其實不大。

cues.en: So the values between, I dunno, we can explore this later in code in the next video, but the values between, you know, let's say maybe minus 0.8 to plus 0.8.
cues.zh: 例如在——下一支影片可以用程式碼探索——大概負 0.8 到正 0.8 之間。

cues.en: I'm just totally eyeballing this, but there is some respectable middle range of correlation coefficient values where the Fisher-Z transform doesn't really do a whole lot,
cues.zh: 這只是目測，但中間有一段不小的相關係數範圍，費雪 Z 轉換其實沒做太多改變，

cues.en: it doesn't change them a whole lot.
cues.zh: 沒有大幅改變數值。

cues.en: And as we get closer and closer to minus one and closer and closer to plus one, then the Fisher-Z transform is gonna have a bigger and bigger effect.
cues.zh: 愈接近負 1，或愈接近正 1，費雪 Z 轉換的影響就愈大。

cues.en: So it's really stretching out the tails of these distributions, and not doing so much with the central part of the distribution
cues.zh: 因此，它主要把分布的尾部拉長，對相關係數分布的

cues.en: of correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 中央部分影響不大。

cues.en: Alright, so in this video, you learned about the Fisher-Z transform.
cues.zh: 這支影片學到了費雪 Z 轉換。

cues.en: Again, if you are computing correlations, just for the correlation to determine the relationship between two variables, you probably don't need to worry
cues.zh: 再次提醒，如果計算相關只是為了判定兩個變數的關係，大概不必擔心

cues.en: about the Fisher-Z transform.
cues.zh: 費雪 Z 轉換。

cues.en: The Fisher-Z transform is usually important for when you're computing lots of correlations across maybe lots of different individuals, and you are pooling those correlations together
cues.zh: 費雪 Z 轉換通常在這種情況比較重要：你對許多不同個體，計算大量相關，再把這些相關彙整，

cues.en: to do some kind of subsequent analysis that makes assumptions about normal distributions, like the T-test or anovas, and so on.
cues.zh: 進行後續分析，而分析對常態分布有假設，例如 t 檢定或 ANOVA 等等。
